stories.title: OpenAI’s quarterly revenue reportedly crosses $10B for the first time
stories.take: Revenue jumped nearly 50% from $6.7B last quarter — scale is real, even as losses stay heavy.

stories.title: Google DeepMind just mathematically verified key parts of Signal
stories.take: A four-week AI formal-verification project hints audits that were impractical are now doable.

stories.title: Nvidia has a Jensen Huang problem—and no obvious successor
stories.take: A board probe plus no clear successor turns a personal scandal into a governance risk for Nvidia.

stories.title: Grok Build coding agent leaks oodles of confidential info, some belonging to SpaceX
stories.take: A researcher found 35,000 Grok Build apps wide open — a warning for every vibe-coding tool.

stories.title: Anthropic launches Claude Meetings to turn workplace discussions into plans and tasks
stories.take: Claude now drafts the plan live in the meeting, whiteboard timeline and all — notes become work.

stories.title: Ring cameras go mobile as Amazon debuts AI-powered security drone and robot
stories.take: Ring stops sitting on the wall: roaming drone and robot devices arrive late 2026 and early 2027.

stories.title: OpenAI Gives Brands Some Data About How They Appear in ChatGPT
stories.take: ChatGPT brand visibility becomes measurable — and OpenAI takes on the GEO-specialist industry.

stories.title: Adobe unveils Photoshop 2027 with a host of new AI features
stories.take: Photoshop 2027 leans hard into AI busywork removal — the retouching grind is the target.

stories.title: Maybelline updates ‘Maybe’ tagline as beauty perceptions evolve
stories.take: A 35-year-old slogan gets new punctuation and phrasing to feel more inclusive, fronted by Miley Cyrus.

stories.title: Prediction Markets Grabbed Midterm Attention. Super Bowl Is Their Next Test
stories.take: Polymarket, Kalshi and Novig proved midterm demand; legal fights and NFL ad limits gate the Super Bowl.

stories.title: Mars wants to future proof impulse buys as AI is poised to take over more grocery runs
stories.take: If an AI agent does the grocery run, the checkout impulse buy dies — Mars is chasing LLM visibility instead.

stories.title: NBA Power Rankings: Lakers thriving behind two-way Luka Dončić, plus a new team at No. 1
stories.take: Lakers sit No. 2 behind two-way Luka, with the Wolves, Celtics and Warriors also rising.

stories.title: Celtics vs. 76ers winners and losers: Jayson Tatum outduels Jaylen Brown, but Paul George steals the show
stories.take: Tatum won the first head-to-head with Brown since the blockbuster trade, but George stole the night in Philly.

stories.title: Cooper Flagg beats LeBron James, Anthony Edwards to NBA history: How the Mavericks star leveled up
stories.take: Flagg is the first teenager in NBA history with five 40-point games — the leap is already historic.

stories.title: The historic (and absurd) longevity of Steph Curry and Kevin Durant
stories.take: At 38, Curry and Durant are still near the top heading into Warriors-Rockets — longevity without precedent.

stories.title: Warriors vs. Rockets: Kevin Durant faces Steph Curry in latest Hall of Fame duel Wednesday
stories.take: Golden State brings an eight-game win streak into Houston for the latest Curry-Durant duel tonight.

stories.title: Source: Astros hiring former catcher Ausmus as new manager
stories.take: Houston turns back the clock: Brad Ausmus, 10 seasons as an Astros catcher, takes the manager job.

stories.title: At MLB GM Meetings, the Phillies are at a crossroads while the Mets have a clear priority
stories.take: The Mets' priority is clear at the GM Meetings; the Phillies face a crossroads with a contender's core.

stories.title: Brewers' Murphy 3-peats as top NL manager; White Sox's Venable wins AL honors
stories.take: Pat Murphy is the first to win NL Manager of the Year three straight years; Will Venable takes the AL award.

stories.title: MLB rumors: Yankees eye Alec Bohm, Tarik Skubal books more meetings
stories.take: Hot stove heats up: Yankees eye Bohm while Skubal — the market's prize ace — books more team meetings.

stories.title: MLB Awards Week: Who will win Cy Young Awards on Wednesday?
stories.take: Cy Young winners land today as Awards Week rolls on — the last big hardware before free agency dominates.

stories.title: House rejects Hegseth impeachment as GOP selects Jordan and Thune as leaders
stories.take: House quashes the Hegseth impeachment for now; Republicans pick Jim Jordan in the House and keep Thune in the Senate.

stories.title: Marco Rubio spent over $1.2m of taxpayer money traveling to son’s football games
stories.take: Ethics watchdogs question $1.2M in taxpayer travel so the secretary of state could watch his son at Florida.

stories.title: ‘The time is now for change.’ Bernie Sanders won't support Schumer for Senate Democratic leader
stories.take: Sanders breaks with Schumer after the Democratic sweep — the victory fight turns into a leadership fight.

stories.title: U.S. inflation report highlights strain of rising food, energy and housing costs
stories.take: Inflation stayed high last month on food, energy and housing — little relief on affordability.

stories.title: Russia and Ukraine agree to a large exchange of prisoners of war, officials say
stories.take: U.S.-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi produce the biggest humanitarian POW release since the war began in 2022.

stories.title: U.S. charges 3 men with plotting terror attacks, including planned assault on UK airbase
stories.take: Prosecutors say an Iran-backed trio plotted attacks, including on a UK base hosting U.S. jets.

stories.title: Cop31 live: ‘Fossil fuels must go the way of the dinosaurs’ - UN chief hits out at industry lobbying
stories.take: At COP31 the UN chief attacks fossil-fuel lobbying while leaders of many big polluting nations stay absent.

stories.title: Nithya Raman's election sets up an intense showdown with the LAPD
stories.take: Mayor-elect Raman faces early calls on the police chief, a new LAPD contract and immigration enforcement.

stories.title: Voters rejected Prop. 45. The battle over California's housing crisis continues
stories.take: Prop. 45's CEQA overhaul divided housing advocates and lost — the fight over how to build continues.

stories.title: With California’s insurance crisis at an impasse, it might be time for a different approach
stories.take: Commissioner-elect Jane Kim's state fire-insurance idea warrants a serious, independent look, CalMatters argues.

stories.title: Two planes nearly collide at LAX after Air France flight veers into another aircraft's path, FAA says
stories.take: An Air France jet turned into an American flight's path on parallel LAX runways Saturday, the FAA says.

stories.title: Bad news for California school repairs: nearly half of bond measures on track to fail
stories.take: Voters rejected billions in school bonds — aging campuses lose their main route to repairs and modernization.

stories.title: New governor begins the ‘Becerra era’ by making nice with Capitol Democrats
stories.take: Gov.-elect Becerra offers collaboration, not specifics, as lawmakers hope for a more collaborative era.

stories.title: Public Schools Have a New Crisis: Not Enough Students
stories.take: Enrollment has fallen in 30 states since ~2014 — LA down 20%, Houston 17%, Chicago 17% — while per-student funding means costs do not shrink with headcount • Pittsburgh lost ~25% in a decade and voted 6-2 to close 12 schools, redraw boundaries citywide and scale back magnets • The district's bet: end magnets as 'white flight within the system' and invest so every neighborhood school offers art, music, STEM, foreign language and 8th-grade algebra

stories.title: Hegseth Impeachment Blocked, House Leadership Change, DOJ Charges Terror Suspects
stories.take: House Republicans referred the Hegseth impeachment to committee on attendance, not merits — Massie was the lone Republican sponsor, and Democrats could revive it when they take control in January • House Republicans chose Jim Jordan over Steve Scalise as minority leader; Senate Republicans kept John Thune • DOJ indicted three Iran-backed operatives over nearly 20 alleged attacks and attempted attacks

stories.title: Tech Stocks Rebound Even As OpenAI Logs Heavy Losses
stories.take: OpenAI Q3 revenue almost doubled to $10B but losses stayed heavy — Anthropic is ahead at $17B with narrower losses and an IPO next week • Tech rallied on TSMC's planned $500M apiece in Anthropic and OpenAI, Alibaba's chip listing plan, and CoreWeave beating Q3 revenue • Trump's Russian diesel deal has stalled: no fuel has arrived, buyers fear EU/UK sanctions despite a U.S. waiver

stories.title: Nvidia Has Lost $1.5 Trillion — Is The Worst Still To Come?
stories.take: Answer: not clearly over — guest Gil Luria calls Nvidia 'one of the highest risk semis,' sees a buying opportunity only in the 70s, and ranks Broadcom, AMD and Micron ahead of it • Nvidia is down >30% from its October high, >$1.5T erased, amid allegations up to ~20% of revenue was funneled to China and no succession plan if Huang steps down • CoreWeave warning: ~3% return on investment vs >9% cost of capital — Luria says stay away

stories.title: Encore: Chuck Klosterman on Why Football Owns TV (and Why It Won’t Forever)
stories.take: Answer: football was accidentally built perfectly for TV — stop-start downtime, constant resets and the central camera create tension and conversation; in 2023, 93 of the 100 most-watched U.S. broadcasts were NFL games • Why it won't last: Klosterman says expansion cannot stop, rights costs will stall, a lockout follows, and a public that no longer plays will drop it like horse racing in the 1920s • Madden and EA College Football taught a generation schematic football before Mahomes made video-game throws real

stories.title: The Perfect Storm That Clobbered Hedge Funds
stories.take: Millennium fell 2.3% in October as Millennium, Balyasny, ExodusPoint and Point72 all lost together — Citadel and D.E. Shaw were positive exceptions • Bloomberg's Nishant Kumar blames a perfect storm: AI stocks crashing, Brazil's election surprise, a junk-bond sell-off and French bonds hitting crowded trades at once • Dozens of portfolio managers were fired or benched, leaving the last ~40 trading days of the year unusually risk-shy

stories.title: So … is the stock market the economy now?
stories.take: Answer: not fully, but the links are stronger than ever — 'new era' AI/software activity grew ~13%/yr over two years vs ~1% for 'old era' activity • Top 10 S&P 500 firms are now 40% of market value, mostly tech, up from 16% a decade ago, with circular AI financing flagged as contagion risk • The Walmart-vs-luxury recession signal, reliable since 1990, has 'really blown out since 2024' — a warning for households outside the market

stories.title: US soldier arrested in UK on suspicion of spying for Russia
stories.take: A 41-year-old senior U.S. soldier at NATO's Allied Rapid Reaction Corps HQ in Gloucestershire was arrested in a joint operation and is held in London under the National Security Act, alleged to be linked to Russia • The BBC also covers the House blocking the Hegseth impeachment for now, with Democrats able to revive it in January • El Salvador's troops in Haiti helped destroy an alleged 400 Mawozo gang HQ as gangs still control most of Port-au-Prince

stories.title: Deadly NoHo pedestrian crash, Ballot tampering claims in LA Council race, Raman returns to City Council— Morning Edition
stories.take: At least 3 dead and 3 hospitalized after an SUV hit a food stand at Lankershim and Chandler in North Hollywood; the driver, a man in his 60s, was arrested on DUI charges • L.A. Council District 9 is down to 156 votes, with ballot-tampering claims referred to the DA — though an unsigned return is not grounds to disqualify a ballot • Mayor-elect Raman returned to City Council promising order and transparency on homelessness from day one

stories.title: Why Apple and Amazon can't stop launching stuff
stories.take: Answer: the big keynote moment is dead — Pierce says one event would let the iPhone Duo swallow everything, so Apple (and Amazon, openly) now drops one product a week for ~six weeks to stay in the news and give each launch its own moment • Apple's bet is being the hardware AI runs on, so it must ship and message constantly • Modular OS verdict: 'cursed' — Fuchsia and CoreOS failed, Android is closest, but Android and iOS already won

stories.title: Russia-Ukraine talks: Prisoner release agreed
stories.take: After nine months with no contact, Abu Dhabi talks agreed a prisoner swap that may be the war's largest — Zelensky cited possibly ~1,500 POWs — with progress on security guarantees but territory still 'the hardest' and no ceasefire • Kushner and Witkoff head to Putin in Moscow, then to Zelensky, who insists Ukraine be treated as an equal • Gaza storms flooded ~70,000 tents in 12 hours, with more than 106,000 families affected

stories.title: DF Direct Q+A: Ex-Sony Boss Calls For $300 PS5 - Should Console Makers Focus On Cost?
stories.take: Answer: focus on cost yes, but a $300 PS5 is probably not achievable — the panel says a PS5-class box still needs 16GB RAM and ~500GB SSD, component prices are rising, and the $300 Series S lost money and lost to the $400 PS5 Digital • A $1,000+ PS6 'is not going to move the needle,' and cloud-only fails on capacity when a GTA 6 launches • Their verdict: hardware is good enough; dev time and budgets are the real bottleneck
